shortDescription: Run and Export iDRAC SupportAssist collection logs

options.name: accept_eula
options.description: This parameter accepts the EULA terms and conditions that are required for SupportAssist registration. If EULA terms and conditions are not accepted, then the SupportAssist collection cannot be run or exported.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: data_collector
options.description: This option provides the choice of data to keep in SupportAssist collection. System Information is available in on the SupportAssist collection by default. C(hardware_data), SupportAssist collection includes data that are related to hardware. C(storage_logs), SupportAssist collection includes logs that are related to storage devices. C(os_app_data), SupportAssist collection includes data that is related to the operating system and applications. C(debug_logs), SupportAssist collection includes lo

options.name: export
options.description: Exports the SupportAssist collection to the given network share. This operation requires I(share_parameters).

options.name: filter_data
options.description: This option provides the choice to filter data for privacy. It does not include hostname, MAC address, thermal data, logs, or registry content.

options.name: idrac_password
options.description: iDRAC user password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export IDRAC_PASSWORD=password

options.name: idrac_user
options.description: iDRAC username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_USERNAME) is used. Example: export IDRAC_USERNAME=username

options.name: job_wait
options.description: This option determines whether to wait for the job completion or not.

options.name: job_wait_timeout
options.description: Time in seconds to wait for job completion. This is applicable when I(job_wait) is C(true).

options.name: resource_id
options.description: Id of the resource. If the value for resource ID is not provided, the module picks the first resource ID available from the list of system resources that are returned by the iDRAC.

options.name: run
options.description: Run the SupportAssist job based on the different types of logs in the collection on iDRAC.

options.name: share_parameters
options.description: Parameters that are required for the export operation of SupportAssist collection. I(share_parameters) is required when I(export) is C(true).

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
